preconditions.description: The number of words n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(w, str) and len(w) >= 1 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word is a non-empty string consisting only of lowercase English letters.
The sum of lengths of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the count modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: output_int == (sum(1 for choices in valid_choice_sequences if is_lex_sorted([get_word(w, c) for w, c in zip(words, choices)])) % 1000000007 if valid_choice_sequences else 0)
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of valid sequences of deletions (one character per word) such that the resulting sequence of words is lexicographically non-decreasing, modulo 10^9+7. If no such sequence exists, the output is 0.
